_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2022 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and amount of subscriber fees paid to NBCUniversal’s television networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ broadband services have become more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2022 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior continue to adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and amount of subscriber fees paid to NBCUniversal’s television networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ broadband services have become more important to consumers.' At the same time it runs its own DTC streaming service: 'Peacock, our DTC streaming service'. The stock trades at 14.4x FY23E — a discount to its own history. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2022 10-K); 'As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming and other OTT services, the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and amount of subscriber fees paid to NBCUniversal’s television networks decrease, even as Cable Communications’ broadband services have become more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.66x; -4% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.05; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.4%/yr (worst year FY13-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.0%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.9%/yr (FY13-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2023-12-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.66x (40.7% downside to Bear $26 / +61.9% upside to Bull $71) | Adj composite 2.25 vs market 2.20: gap +0.05 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -4% above the EPP floor $46 (15x FY23E $3.04) | Conservative 2-yr case: +25.6% total (+12.8%/yr) | At 14.4x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $58 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -12.6% in Q3 2023, forward revenues +0.9% (no FY23 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2023 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
